## Goal

Describe the user-visible outcome.

## Classification

- Phase: M0 / M1 / Launch / Later / Good-to-have / Wish
- Area:
- Status: proposed

## Scope

Describe the bounded change and relevant user roles.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior and meaningful verification.
- [ ] Tenant/resource authorization and privacy.
- [ ] Consent, pause and revocation behavior where applicable.

## Dependencies

Link the prerequisite issues.

## Implementation notes

Record migrations, jobs, storage, notification and operational implications. Use synthetic examples only.
